list.name: venue
list.label: Venue
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT venue FROM occupancy ORDER BY venue;

targets.rawSql:
-- refresh on: ${palette}
-- Canonical definition lives in sql/migrations/005_public_api.sql; the public
-- page reads the same functions through public.gym_heatmap()/gym_live().
SELECT 'typical'::text AS kind, hour, typical_count AS count, samples
FROM api_private.gym_panel1_typical_rows(${venue:sqlstring})
UNION ALL
SELECT 'now'::text, hour, current_count, 1::bigint
FROM api_private.gym_panel1_now_rows(${venue:sqlstring})
UNION ALL
SELECT 'meta'::text, NULL::int, n, NULL::bigint
FROM api_private.gym_panel1_meta_rows(${venue:sqlstring})
ORDER BY kind DESC, hour;
